Rubick is a hero that I have fun with, but I always feel like I do not contribute very much during team fights. My experience is that Rubick is obviously too squishy to be in the middle of the team fight, but still needs to be close enough to steal the desirable spells.

My general build is to get boots --> force staff --> blink dagger/mek/eul's --> agh's
Any tips for playing support Rubick?

• You don't have to steal the big spells every team fight.

  • Think about your positioning. You want to cover your friends with your null field aura for as long as you can.

  • You are doing just fine if lifting up one important hero is all you ever did that teamfight.

  • Try to get a blink dagger after boots and wards. It is seriously strong with your Q.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pHrKuJ2HNLY <---- Do like this guy. He's mid, but at shit-tier pub dota it doesn't matter, your games will always go late and you will always find farm no matter what.

One thing to note, he picks rubick into a game in which nearly every spell he steals is useful. Most people see a big ult like enigma or tide and then lock in rubick while the rest of the enemy team isn't nearly as useful. This is bad, because unless you steal that key spell, you are basically just lifting and dropping all game. This guy gets stun after stun after stun and uses them masterfully.

I only have about 10-20 games on Rubick, but so far I have a 100% win rate with him.

I only pick him when the enemy team has some nice wombo combos or good spells to steal. (I love taking techie mines). Also, ultimates are nice to steal, but not required. Any spell with a CC is always going to be great to steal.

Boots --> Blink Dagger is your core build, seeing as you can get great pick offs with your blink Q combo. I go for an extra utility item as well like a glimmer cape or crest (which are OP this patch). I don't go Mek as I dislike his mana pool and he spams spells often, but if no one else gets it, go ahead.

As for team fighting, a supports basic role is to stay away and only use your spells. You don't need to autoattack to be useful. Blink, Q, run back, blink around, cast bolt and Q some more. You want to stay close enough for your aura but distance yourself from the enemy.

Fun tip, try to throw people up on cliffs and get a good laugh out of it. If you can ward the cliff and cancel their TP with your Q every time, you win the game.
